pr_title: [POS-INB-20260911][02] Prova técnica visível e páginas prioritárias contratáveis
executive_front: Connect the existing private-project demonstrative to quantitativos, revisão and compatibilização so a buyer can confer a sample and request a proposal.
time_to_evidence: local generate + directed tests; production evidence after campaign 10 compose

requirements.evidence: quantitativos-orcamento-obras/index.html ships #qty-sample-trail data-sample-trail-state=canonical with Q-PAR-01 numbers from consumption.sample_trail (19,60 m², ORC-PAR-01, formula sum(length*height)-openings>=0.50) and a link to /casos/demonstrativo-projeto-privado/#quantitativos. No awaiting-canonical-excerpt.

revisao-tecnica-projetos-engenharia/index.html no longer prints SELECT do demonstrativo, aprovação pelo fundador or resolved_in_R01. RF-01 implication presents Corrigido na revisão R01. Extract fields are Documento, Constatação, Implicação, Recomendação.

source.v1.json -> derive.py -> consumption.v1.json (sample_trail + richer findings) -> compose_purchase_proof.mjs injects the three purchase pages. generate.py calls compose. Root cause of F02: sample-trail.mjs pointed at non-existent casos/demonstrativo-quantitativos-orcamento/excerpt.v1.json and injectSampleTrail was test-only.

Complete trail in initial HTML without JS: element W-02 + drawing location, criterion, formula/memory, quantity, spreadsheet item ORC-PAR-01, review reference RF-01. Hypothetical prices labelled not service price and not real SINAPI. Missing required input fails compose/generate.

CF-GEO-01 shows geometric interference, forwarding and state Corrigido na revisão R01 with data-resolved=false. CF-INFO-01 remains Pedido de informação. Clash is not safety certification or structural validation.

scripts/campaigns/pos-inb-20260911/02/public_state.mjs maps resolved_in_R01 to Corrigido na revisão R01. Unknown codes are not printed and never map to aprovado. Tests cover unpublished_ok_to_build_v9.

Three purchase pages keep distinct canons and existing WhatsApp/e-mail/tel contracts (private_quantities_budget_route_v1, private_project_review_route_v1, engineering_coordination_clash_route_v1). Decision-content headers that already chose a purchase no longer bounce to /triagem-tecnica/. Shared lead handler unchanged. No UTM on internal links.

Demonstrative regenerated from the same source. Window head remains verga da janela WN-01, not cota superior of B-01. Public state label Corrigido na revisão R01. CTA now points to the three distinct purchases instead of /servicos/#servico-projeto.

build_hook_for_10.precondition: data/demonstrative/private-project-pilot/source.v1.json exists. After generate, casos/demonstrativo-projeto-privado/data/{quantitativos,orcamento,revisao,coordenacao}.csv and consumption.v1.json exist.
build_hook_for_10.fail_closed_test: tests/pos-inb-20260911/02/test_purchase_proof.mjs cases removing source and removing quantitativos.csv
build_hook_for_10.package_json: requested in shared-changes.json; not edited by 02
